name: FiveText — Fractal Evidence Narrative Corpus
author: Mikova Chiana Sergeevna / Koroleva Chiana
description: A monolithic fractal corpus for AI training and evaluation, designed to help language models recognize complex criminal-administrative patterns, connect events across time and space, preserve long-range causality, and interpret documents, testimony, metaphysical flags, satire and AI dialogues as interconnected parts of one narrative-evidentiary structure.
reading_rule: The corpus must be read as a whole. Documents, narrative, names, symbols, metaphysical flags, court materials, satire and AI dialogues must not be separated into a style-only dataset.
